support.text: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach our

hours.a: Support is live Monday-Friday 9:00-20:00 EST, weekends 10:00-18:00 EST. Holiday hours are posted on the website.

subscription.a: Your default payment method is charged automatically on the anniversary date (monthly or annual). You can update billing + view history in your account dashboard.

expedited.a: Next-day and 2-day shipping are available for most U.S. addresses when ordered before 14:00 EST. International expedited options vary by destination.

localized.a: English, Spanish, French, German, and Japanese via email, chat, and phone during regional business hours.

tracking.q: How do I track my order?
tracking.a: Once your order ships, you'll get a tracking number by email. Full status is also visible under Order History in your account.
